excluded.H005: UNRESOLVED_CONTRADICTION - excluded from groundwater hypothesis testing

roles_frozen.note: roles must not be changed because of groundwater results

station_selection.distance_basis: great-circle distance from station coordinates to the frozen Phase-I hotspot centroid
station_selection.select: ALL quality-passing stations within 5 km; no selection by trend, correlation, seasonal behaviour or visual similarity
station_selection.unequal_station_counts: expected and reported explicitly; sample size is not forced equal across hotspots
station_selection.distance_weighting: NOT used in the primary analysis; sensitivity only

station_qc_rules.zeros_not_globally_assumed_impossible: provider metadata does not establish a sentinel convention, so zeros are judged only through the frozen fraction rules

temporal_aggregation.raw_preserved: six-hourly observations kept unchanged and authoritative for provenance
temporal_aggregation.daily_statistic: median of valid six-hourly observations that day

sign_convention.larger_mbgl_means: deeper groundwater table / decline relative to land surface

station_datum_handling.primary_representation: depth anomaly relative to that station's own record median
station_datum_handling.composite: HOTSPOT_GW_COMPOSITE(t) = median of available station anomalies

composite_availability_rule.single_station_hotspot: reported explicitly as single-station evidence, not as a spatial composite

gap_handling.insar_epoch_in_gap: unavailable for that test; no extrapolation

insar_alignment.series_used: authoritative ASCENDING hotspot time series (product_v1 / RAW-336)
insar_alignment.reason: the ascending product remains the authoritative deformation solution; descending validates rate/spatial behaviour for H001/H004 but not their detailed displacement histories
insar_alignment.window_type: centred on the InSAR acquisition date, t-3 to t+3
insar_alignment.statistic: median of the daily groundwater composite in that window
insar_alignment.otherwise: groundwater value = missing for that epoch

test_A_long_term.question: does groundwater systematically deepen or recover over the study period in a way consistent with the broad deformation evolution

test_B_detrended.question: after removing long-term behaviour, do groundwater anomalies and relative LOS displacement covary temporally

lags.interpretation: lag +30 means the groundwater state precedes the InSAR response by approximately 30 days
lags.negative_lag_role: falsification diagnostics only; may NOT be used to support the groundwater hypothesis

association_metrics.rationale: neither groundwater nor InSAR residuals should be assumed Gaussian

multiple_testing.family: 4 hotspots x 4 primary positive lags = 16 hotspot-composite tests
multiple_testing.station_level_results: supporting / sensitivity evidence, NOT independent primary hypothesis tests

expected_sign.expected_association: negative correlation between GW_DEPTH_ANOMALY and LOS displacement, i.e. deeper groundwater -> more negative LOS
expected_sign.caveat: LOS is not a vertical-only measurement

positive_case_requirement: multiple nearby stations behave consistently where available
positive lags perform at least as well as negative/falsification lags
result is not driven by one short interval

mandatory_controls.reason: their ascending contrasts are similar to H004 but their rates are NOT reproduced in descending despite adequate descending quality; a groundwater mechanism becomes less selective if the controls behave equally strongly
mandatory_controls.comparison_is_required: H001/H004 vs H002/H003, not merely per-hotspot tests

coherence_confounding.test: does the groundwater association survive using only high-confidence / strict-quality InSAR pixels

outage_sensitivity.procedure: remove 30 days before and 30 days after each major gap, then repeat any apparently meaningful result

leave_one_station_out.for_H001_with_2_stations: report both station results individually in addition to the composite

STRONG: expected-direction association in H001 and/or H004
groundwater behaviour more specific to supported zones than H002/H003
evidence_grading.MODERATE: multiple lines consistent but one major limitation remains (sparse local network, large outage, control ambiguity, limited robustness)
evidence_grading.WEAK: some temporal/spatial consistency but small/unstable effect, station dependence, similar controls, ambiguous lag direction, or strong data limitations
evidence_grading.NO_EVIDENCE: no consistent preregistered association, or predominantly contradictory evidence

interpretation_boundary.even_a_STRONG_result_means: strong evidence consistent with groundwater-related deformation
interpretation_boundary.it_does_not_mean: groundwater depletion caused the observed subsidence
why: LOS is not a pure vertical measurement
H001/H004 temporal histories are not independently reproduced by descending
